thread:
maria: just got node gpu-usw2-45 back from vendor, ran quick test and saw intermittent Xid 13 in dmesg. Putting it through soak now.
ajay: can you paste dmesg snippet and nvidia-smi ECC read?
maria: dmesg: "NVRM: Xid (13): GPU has fallen off the bus" repeated 3x. nvidia-smi -q -d ECC shows single-bit errors increasing (ecc single bit : 7 -> 9 during quick test).
kevin: hmm that sounds like flaky PCI link. did you reseat the riser? vendor said they'd reseated.
maria: they did. I kicked off soakbench for 8h: `./soakbench --node gpu-usw2-45 --duration 8h --workload lm-infer --seq 1024 --p99-target 200ms`
sre-bot: soakbench run started for gpu-usw2-45 (run id sb-20260318-01)
jen: add power cycling into the burn-in: `ipmitool -I lanplus -H <BMC> -U admin chassis power cycle`
ajay: also run `stress-ng --gpu 1 --timeout 2h` inside maintenance container to isolate drivers.
maria: current plan: 8h soak + 2h stress-ng + kernel boot log capture. If Xid > 5 occurrences after that mark for RMA escalation.
kevin: note: can't drain additional nodes from us-west-2 today; we're at 90% utilisation for training jobs. If this node repeats failures we may need hot-swap policy.
maria: agreed. If soak fails and vendor RMA returns another unit, escalate to replace riser and different slot.
ajay: put this node in 'quarantine' tag in inventory: `invctl tag gpu-usw2-45 quarantine` and create a jira: INF-4521
maria: created INF-4521 with logs attached, linking soak run sb-20260318-01. I'll post updates here.
kevin: one more: collect `sudo nvme smart-log /dev/nvme0` in case it's PSU/PCI related.
jen: ack. If soak passes, run 24h soft-soak (reduced load) before returning to pool.
maria: update: after 3h Xid popped again. attaching snippet: "NVRM: Xid (13) 0x00000000 0x0000abcd"
ajay: ok, vendor escalation time. tagging vendor@support :phone: 
vendor-bot: RMA opened RMA-98765 for gpu-usw2-45. ETA replacement 72h.
kevin: thanks. documenting steps for next time: reseat riser, power cycle, 8h soakbench, 2h stress-ng, collect ECC counts & nvme logs, if repeat -> RMA.
maria: adding checklist to ops-runbook: /docs/rma-burnin-guides.md :+1:
kevin: :thumbsup:
